name: Fixture Programme Endeavour
description: Exercises orchestration embedding: a programme shape that places a whole project endeavour owned by another practice, rather than restating that endeavour's stages.

patterns.name: Tranche Plan
patterns.description: A programme delivered in successive tranches, each closing on a benefit the programme promised.

patternViews.name: Shape the Tranche
patternViews.description: Agree what benefit this tranche is for and what will show it was realised.

patternViews.name: Realise the Benefit
patternViews.description: Run the tranche to the point where the promised benefit is observable.

patterns.name: Benefits Review
patterns.description: A standing review of whether the benefits claimed are the benefits being realised.

patternViews.name: Measure
patternViews.description: Take the measures the tranche said would show the benefit.

patternViews.name: Decide
patternViews.description: Decide whether to continue, reshape or stop on the evidence.

patternOrchestrations.name: Programme Endeavour
patternOrchestrations.description: A programme delivering benefits through successive tranches, with a platform endeavour running inside each tranche and benefits review alongside the whole.

exitCriteria.name: Tranche platform is in service
exitCriteria.description: Whether the platform endeavour run inside this tranche reached service.
when: the platform endeavour run inside it completes
then: the tranche has a platform carrying the workloads it promised
